solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.

extra90: Cada aluno escolhe a palavra mais útil e explica por quê.

facts.label: Reflexivos no plural
facts.sub: No plural, self vira selves: ourselves, yourselves, themselves. We built it ourselves. They did it themselves.

facts.label: Nós mesmos
facts.sub: Use ourselves quando nós fazemos algo sem ajuda: We built it ourselves. We taught ourselves. Também use by ourselves para dizer sozinhos.

facts.label: Vocês mesmos
facts.sub: Use yourselves para duas ou mais pessoas: Did you do it yourselves? Enjoy yourselves! O singular é yourself, o plural termina em selves.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “nós mesmos fizemos”, e muitas vezes o pronome se perde.
compare.us: Em inglês, use ourselves: We built it ourselves. Para “vocês”, use yourselves. Para “eles”, use themselves.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

answers: Ourselves is for “we”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The plural of yourself is yourselves. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “theirselves” in correct English. → Falso (We say themselves.)

pages.title: A back yard garden · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Sunday morning in Austin, Texas. Gus stands in the back yard of his house. Green plants grow in long wooden beds. His friend Ben walks through the gate. A watering can sits next to the tomatoes. Gus feels proud of his work.

“Ben, look at the garden! We built these beds ourselves.” says Gus. “Wow, you did all this yourselves? Nobody helped you?” says Ben. “Nobody. My wife and I watched videos and taught ourselves.” says Gus.
